# Vulpkanin
They can eat raw meat without any ill effects, but some foods like chocolate and onion poisons them. They suffocate 50% faster, but have the ability to identify chemical compositions.
Vulpkanin bite for their unarmed attack, dealing Piercing damage instead of Blunt.
They take [color=#1e90ff]30% less Cold damage[/color] but [color=#ffa500]30% more Heat damage, and catch on fire more easily[/color].
